title: Swagger/OpenAPI
definition: Swagger (OpenAPI) is a specification for machine-readable interface files for describing, producing, consuming, and visualizing RESTful web services. You can use packages like `swagger-ui-express` to automatically generate a beautiful, interactive documentation page directly from your Express code.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Swagger/OpenAPI?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
